name: GoDaddy-style reusable SEO and delivery patterns
classification: observed reproducible techniques, not proprietary ranking secrets

patterns.use: Write language-native titles and descriptions around the exact problem, truthful jurisdiction, relevant professional or service term, and a real differentiator.
Connect the organization, founder or reviewer, profile page, visible attribution, and stable structured-data IDs.
Create stable, substantive problem pages under region, language, and service hierarchies with contextual internal links.
Generate navigation, SSR, canonical, hreflang, social metadata, sitemap, and prerender behavior from the same URL inventory.
Reduce repeated HTML data, split noncritical code and translations, compress responses, cache public HTML briefly, and cache hashed assets immutably.
Serve right-sized modern images, preload only the LCP image, and lazy-load noncritical media.

requiredOutcomeData: Google Search Console query and page metrics
